model.label: UniTacWAM
model.inputs: RGB + proprioception + tactile + action history + task instruction
model.trainingSetting: Unified visuo-tactile world action model (one model for parallel grippers and dexterous hands, unified action space). Multi-task fine-tuned from a pretrained foundation model on all 26 tasks: 5 window epochs, global batch 640, LR 1e-4 cosine; single checkpoint step 25738
model.evaluationSetting: 26 tasks, four channels, 50 episodes per task/channel; fixed checkpoint across all tasks; IK: default bridge IK, GWP-style IK on the 11 tasks with 7-DoF arms (03 09 22 26 32 51 61 62 64 73 79)

protocol.expertReference: Native per-episode expert_time_step, in physics steps.
protocol.protocolChanges: UniTacWAM policy server + Bench2Dex policy bridge (absolute EEF targets in robot base -> IK). One checkpoint for all 26 tasks. IK: default bridge IK on 15 tasks; on the 11 tasks with 7-DoF arms (03 09 22 26 32 51 61 62 64 73 79) the bridge IK runs in a GWP-style mode (joint-limit preference + re-solve on large joint jumps). Native physics budgets, seeds and stable-success dwell recorded in logs. Episodes interrupted by infrastructure were resumed with the same seeds; no scored episode replaced; all failures kept in the denominators.

aggregation.sr: 100 * successes / episodes per task/channel; equal channel mean per task; equal task mean over all 26 tasks.
aggregation.lscr: 100 * mean native latched_stage_completion_rate including failures; equal channel and task means.
aggregation.efficiency: Per task, expert time divided by mean time_to_stable_success pooled over successful episodes from all four channels. Overall is the mean of valid task efficiencies.
aggregation.errors: 5200 episodes, 3403 successes, 0 error episodes; episodes with errors would count as failures.
aggregation.missing: null means unreported (NR). Efficiency without successes is null with no-success status. Valid-task counts are null when unreported, and 0 for an evaluated scope without successes.
aggregation.scope: Overall channel aggregates require all 26 settings. Four-channel means require all four channels. Never substitute Full-only scores for means or include duplicate reruns.
